description: This file defines a custom Android Button subclass named SystemPointerIconButton that overrides the onResolvePointerIcon method to provide custom pointer icons based on touch position within the button.

classes.name: SystemPointerIconButton
classes.description: A custom Button that modifies the pointer icon depending on touch location.

methods.name: SystemPointerIconButton
methods.description: Constructors initializing the button with various context and attribute parameters.

methods.name: onResolvePointerIcon
methods.description: Overridden method to determine which PointerIcon to display based on the touch event's position.
